ask: On a rain-wet steel platform high inside a reactor shaft, Veyr walks toward the reactor core. Mara cuts across the platform and blocks him, forearm against forearm, turning him off his line. 4 seconds, 2D action anime.

clip.objective: the viewer sees that Veyr wants the core and that Mara's block, not chance, takes him off his line
clip.dramatic_function: interception: a pursuit becomes coupled contact

pass_plan.reason: reasoned: nothing in the environment changes state inside this beat; rain and the platform are fixed setting, stated on the environment entity
reasoned, covered by interaction and physics: the walk, the run and the block are fully described by the beats, the pathway and the physics event (same choice as runs 003 and 004)
one body-on-body contact with a stated reaction and settle
two actors on crossing paths and a goal in the background: screen sides must hold
reasoned: nothing must persist beyond identity and wardrobe, which the entity locks carry
the block's movement quality is the wording under test in experiment E3
mandatory: explicit camera grammar, one catalog move
reasoned: nothing is withheld; the contact is at frame centre by the camera's end state
reasoned: not asked; the fight IR's lighting accents belong to later beats
the owner's fight IR fixes the medium: contemporary 2D action anime
reasoned: not asked; the fight IR's storm bed is outside the experiment

entities.description: Veyr, a tall man in a long charcoal coat, is on the left of a rain-wet steel platform, facing the reactor core
Mara, a woman in a short dark red jacket with her hair tied back, stands on the right of the platform, nearer the camera
The platform hangs high inside a reactor shaft in falling rain; the reactor core glows inside its ring in the far right background

stages.description: Mara shifts her weight and commits to the run
she closes the distance across his path
her left forearm meets the outside of his raised right forearm
the momentum of her run goes into his arm
his arm and shoulders are turned away from the core
stages.reaction: Veyr's arm is pushed off his line and he gives a full step sideways

stages.description: they hold, forearm against forearm, Mara between him and the core

beats.label: Veyr heads for the core
beats.description: Veyr walks straight across the platform toward the core, eyes fixed on it
beats.min_s_origin: PROJECT_DERIVED convention (run-001 reading times: one readable baseline action)

beats.label: Mara cuts across
beats.description: Mara sprints diagonally across the platform into his path
beats.min_s_origin: PROJECT_DERIVED convention (one bounded motion with anticipation)

beats.label: the interception
beats.description: Mara meets him in the middle of the platform
beats.min_s_origin: PROJECT_DERIVED convention (contact, reaction and a held settle; four pathway stages)

anchors.label: Veyr's walk
anchors.description: Veyr strides at a steady walking pace, one even step after another

anchors.label: Veyr's footfalls
anchors.description: Each of his boots comes down flat on the wet steel with an ordinary, even weight

physics_events.contact_surface: the outside of his raised right forearm
physics_events.primary_reaction: Veyr's arm is pushed off his line and he gives a full step sideways
secondary: his shoulders turn away from the core
physics_events.settle: they hold forearm against forearm, Mara standing between him and the core
must_not_imply: a punch to the face or body
one forearm passing through the other
Veyr leaving his line before the forearms meet
the two bouncing apart to neutral stances

controls.value: A 4-second animated clip, one continuous shot, no cuts
Contemporary 2D hand-drawn action anime: clean line art, flat cel shading, clear readable silhouettes
controls.expected_visual_effect: drawn 2D animation, not live action or 3D render
controls.check: line art and flat shading on both figures

controls.value: Veyr moves left to right toward the core; Mara comes from the right; they meet mid-frame
controls.expected_visual_effect: screen sides hold: Veyr from the left, Mara from the right, the core far right
controls.check: neither figure swaps sides; the core stays in the far right background

value.subject: Mara
value.visible: Mara's block starts in her planted rear foot, turns through her hips and shoulders, and arrives with her whole body behind the forearm

controls.expected_visual_effect: the block is delivered by the whole body: foot plants, hips and shoulders turn, the forearm arrives last
controls.check: rear foot planted before contact; hips turn before the forearm lands

controls.value: Wide shot from chest height, wide lens, both figures full-length, the core in the far background
controls.expected_visual_effect: both bodies and both paths readable before the contact
controls.check: both figures full-length at the start

value.phrase: dolly in toward the point where their paths cross
value.movement: move the camera straight forward toward the meeting point
value.framing: keep height and lens direction constant, both figures fully in frame
value.end: finish medium-wide with the forearm contact at frame centre

controls.expected_visual_effect: the frame tightens on the meeting point; the contact is visible, not hidden
controls.check: forearm contact inside the frame in the last second

value: extra limbs or a third figure
controls.expected_visual_effect: none of the listed failures appear

notes: Specimen: the interception from the owner's fight IR (Additional/TERMINAL_DESCENT_FIGHT_IR_v1.json: beats b01-b02, contact c01_forearm_redirect, action a01). One contact, one physics event.
Left out of this single-beat specimen: Veyr's mass-debt rail charge and release, the glass partition, Mara's shoulder injury, the camera impulse, the storm audio bed.
No beat declares spacing: the spacing clauses contain speed words ('arriving fast', 'starting slow') that would blur the magnitude arms of E2 (decision d005).
No short wording anywhere: every arm must emit without compression so the arms differ only in the wording under test.

No interaction.causal_chain control and no key-pose line: the physics event already states cause, contact, reaction and settle, and a second statement of the same contact would push the arms over the limit (decision d006).
